verdict.rationale: Payment links are a fair question for a payment processor, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions no-code payment links or shareable checkout pages. The dashboard references cover only data, reconciliation and exports, and the API overview says dashboard operations exist without naming payment-link creation, so they are adjacent rather than direct support.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately
